authority: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure documentation on docs.oracle.com and oracle.com

methodology.documentedFacts: Service names and capability summaries are paraphrased from the linked official Oracle documentation.
methodology.architecturalInference: Interlock arrows, operating loops, outcomes, and implementation recommendations are independent reference-architecture inferences, not Oracle product guarantees.
methodology.maintenance: Recheck source URLs and service behavior before production design decisions because OCI capabilities and availability can change.

sources.documentedCapability: Collects service and custom metrics, evaluates MQL queries, and provides the metric foundation for health and capacity views.
sources.architecturalInference: Turns network, security, IAM, workload, quota, and lifecycle measurements into shared health indicators and alarm inputs.

sources.documentedCapability: Stores and searches enabled OCI service logs and custom logs in log groups; custom sources can use the Logging API or Unified Monitoring Agent.
sources.architecturalInference: Provides a shared record of network, security, workload, and operational activity when the relevant service or custom logs are explicitly enabled and routed.

sources.documentedCapability: Detects resource lifecycle and state changes and routes matching events to notification or automation targets.
sources.architecturalInference: Converts infrastructure, policy, security, onboarding, and lifecycle changes into event-driven operational workflows.

sources.documentedCapability: The Monitoring service evaluates metric queries and publishes alarm messages when configured trigger rules and state transitions are met.
sources.architecturalInference: Makes measured conditions actionable by connecting Monitoring alarm messages to Notifications topics and approved downstream incident or automation workflows.

sources.documentedCapability: Publishes messages through topics and subscriptions to people, HTTPS endpoints, functions, and supported delivery channels.
sources.architecturalInference: Routes alarm, event, risk, budget, and lifecycle messages to the accountable team or downstream automation platform.

sources.documentedCapability: Provides tenancy-relevant notices about service events, planned maintenance, advisories, and other operational information in the OCI Console.
sources.architecturalInference: Adds provider-originated context to incident triage, readiness planning, maintenance windows, and service reporting when teams actively consume the notices.

sources.documentedCapability: Indexes and enriches log and event records for interactive search, clustering, link analysis, anomaly detection, and root-cause investigation.
sources.architecturalInference: Correlates logs and events with adjacent signals by shared time, entity, and trace context. Prometheus exporter metrics stay in a metric backend and can be paired with Logan evidence; APM traces remain a linked service under the current published service boundary.

sources.documentedCapability: Provides distributed tracing, Availability Monitoring, real-user monitoring, server monitoring, and dashboards for application performance analysis.
sources.architecturalInference: Connects customer-experience and transaction evidence with application components, downstream services, and operational changes when instrumentation is deployed.

sources.documentedCapability: Discovers supported application-stack resources and topology, then collects status, load, response, error, and utilization metrics into OCI Monitoring.
sources.architecturalInference: Supplies topology and health context for incident triage and connects supported application-layer symptoms with underlying servers and databases.

sources.documentedCapability: Analyzes long-term database and host utilization, SQL behavior, capacity trends, and enterprise-wide performance history.
sources.architecturalInference: Adds forecasting and trend evidence to capacity, lifecycle, database, FinOps, and operational-readiness decisions.

sources.documentedCapability: Provides near-real-time inventory, relationship, and configuration metadata through SQL, property graphs, and analytics dashboards.
sources.architecturalInference: Adds multiregion resource ownership and dependency context to compliance monitoring, troubleshooting, dashboards, and impact analysis.

sources.documentedCapability: Provides fleet health, performance diagnostics, SQL monitoring, configuration visibility, and management for Oracle databases.
sources.architecturalInference: Connects database-specific evidence with application incidents, lifecycle operations, fleet readiness, and executive capacity reporting.

sources.documentedCapability: Produces prioritized recommendations for cost, security, availability, performance, and operational improvement across OCI resources.
sources.architecturalInference: Turns observed configuration and usage into governed recommendations that can be assigned, tracked, validated, and reported.

sources.documentedCapability: Provides predefined and customizable reports for analyzing OCI cost and usage with filters, grouping, saved reports, and scheduled reports.
sources.architecturalInference: Combines cost-and-usage reports with organization-approved ownership and utilization context for allocation, showback, chargeback, and optimization review.

sources.documentedCapability: Service limits define allowed capacity, compartment quotas constrain resource consumption, and budgets provide soft spending thresholds with periodic alerts.
sources.architecturalInference: Connects separately governed capacity and spending controls to planning, owner notification, escalation, and evidence without treating budgets as hard enforcement.

sources.documentedCapability: Shows a cross-region list of resources in a selected compartment and, when requested, its subcompartments, subject to permissions and supported resource types.
sources.architecturalInference: Adds operator-selected resource scope and regional inventory context to dashboards and investigations; it is a Console discovery capability, not a telemetry service.

sources.documentedCapability: Governs parent and child tenancies, subscription mapping, organization-wide visibility, and supported cross-tenancy administration models.
sources.architecturalInference: Extends observability ownership, reporting, budgets, and policy evidence across enterprise tenancy and subscription boundaries.

sources.documentedCapability: Provides the software-defined network boundary for subnets, routing, gateways, security controls, DNS, and private connectivity.
sources.architecturalInference: Emits metrics, flow records, configuration events, and path context used to assess reachability, availability, and change impact.

sources.documentedCapability: Distributes traffic across healthy backends and publishes listener, backend, latency, connection, and error metrics for service health.
sources.architecturalInference: Links customer-facing availability and latency to backend health, alarms, notifications, topology, and incident workflows.

sources.documentedCapability: Applies managed network security policy and produces traffic, threat, and rule evidence for controlled VCN boundaries.
sources.architecturalInference: Feeds allowed and denied traffic context into security analytics, network diagnosis, policy review, and incident investigation.

sources.documentedCapability: Performs configuration-based reachability analysis across OCI network paths without sending traffic through the production environment.
sources.architecturalInference: Supplies path validation and likely failure-point context to troubleshooting dashboards, change validation, and remediation workflows.

sources.documentedCapability: Detects risky resource configurations and suspicious activities through detector recipes and tracks them as prioritized problems.
sources.architecturalInference: Contributes security findings and posture signals that observability correlates with logs, identities, changes, workloads, and ownership.

sources.documentedCapability: Enforces preventive security policies on compartments so resource operations comply with an approved security-zone recipe.
sources.architecturalInference: Produces policy-violation and control context for posture monitoring, onboarding validation, audit evidence, and remediation.

sources.documentedCapability: Manages encryption keys and secrets with controlled access, lifecycle operations, protection modes, and audit visibility.
sources.architecturalInference: Adds key usage, secret access, rotation, and cryptographic lifecycle evidence to security and compliance investigations.

sources.documentedCapability: Creates, imports, deploys, and renews certificates and certificate authorities for supported OCI services and workloads.
sources.architecturalInference: Provides expiry and lifecycle events that drive alerts, readiness checks, change workflows, and cryptographic compliance evidence.

sources.documentedCapability: Controls tenancy resources through users, groups, dynamic groups, compartments, policies, authentication, and authorization decisions.
sources.architecturalInference: Provides actor, policy, compartment, and access-boundary context needed to explain who changed what and whether it was allowed.

sources.documentedCapability: Provides identity lifecycle, federation, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, and application integration within OCI IAM.
sources.architecturalInference: Emits identity and federation activity that supports login monitoring, access investigations, governance evidence, and risk response.

sources.documentedCapability: Supports access review, certification, entitlement insight, identity lifecycle governance, and risk-aware access decisions.
sources.architecturalInference: Adds review status, entitlement, dormant-account, and privilege evidence to IAM dashboards, compliance reports, and remediation.

sources.documentedCapability: Automatically records calls to supported OCI public API endpoints, including caller, time, source, target, action, and response information.
sources.architecturalInference: Provides API-activity evidence for identity, policy, network, security, resource, and tenancy investigations within documented retention and permission boundaries.

sources.documentedCapability: Provides standardized architecture and automation patterns for tenancy, IAM, network, security, governance, and workload foundations.
sources.architecturalInference: Embeds telemetry, logs, alarms, ownership, retention, and readiness checks into repeatable cloud-foundation blueprints.

sources.documentedCapability: Moves data between supported OCI source and target services, optionally invoking Functions for transformation during delivery.
sources.architecturalInference: Connects Logging with analytics, archive, streaming, SIEM, functions, and other operational destinations through managed pipelines.

sources.documentedCapability: Centralizes operating-system update, software-source, lifecycle-environment, compliance, and fleet management across supported environments.
sources.architecturalInference: Contributes patch status, errata, job results, and compliance signals to readiness dashboards, tickets, and lifecycle reports.

sources.documentedCapability: Groups application resources into fleets to automate maintenance tasks, validate compliance, and coordinate enterprise lifecycle operations.
sources.architecturalInference: Provides fleet membership, maintenance execution, patch compliance, and workflow evidence to operations and executive reporting.

sources.documentedCapability: Groups supported application-stack resources into DR Protection Groups and runs customizable, pretested plans for planned or unplanned DR operations.
sources.architecturalInference: Adds supported DR-plan execution and validation evidence to reporting; RPO, RTO, replication, and backup health require workload-specific sources and controls.

sources.documentedCapability: Provides managed, scalable email delivery with operational metrics for accepted, relayed, bounced, complained, and suppressed messages.
sources.architecturalInference: Adds delivery health and failure signals to customer operations, service-management reporting, and alert-delivery assurance.

diagramPatterns.title: OCI Observability × Cloud Network Interlock
diagramPatterns.statement: Show how OCI Observability services interlock with OCI networking to collect telemetry, analyze traffic and firewall logs, validate reachability, monitor health, automate response, and improve reliability, security visibility, and operational readiness.

diagramPatterns.title: OCI Observability × Cloud Security Interlock
diagramPatterns.statement: Show how OCI Observability services interlock with OCI security services to collect security-relevant logs, monitor posture, detect events, correlate findings, support investigations, generate compliance evidence, and improve SecOps readiness.

diagramPatterns.title: OCI Observability × IAM and Governance Interlock
diagramPatterns.statement: Show how OCI Observability services interlock with IAM and governance to monitor access, capture audit trails, detect policy changes, track tenancy structure, govern compartments, alert on risk, support compliance evidence, and improve cloud operating-model maturity.

diagramPatterns.title: OCI Observability × Landing Zone Design Interlock
diagramPatterns.statement: Show how observability is embedded in landing-zone architecture so every cloud-foundation blueprint begins with standardized monitoring, logging, alarms, ownership, evidence collection, governance reporting, and readiness validation.

diagramPatterns.title: OCI Observability × Operations Advisory and Lifecycle Management Interlock
diagramPatterns.statement: Show how observability interlocks with operations advisory and lifecycle capabilities to improve incident response, fleet operations, patching, integration, database operations, disaster-recovery readiness, FinOps visibility, sustainability reporting, and cloud operations maturity.

diagramPatterns.title: End-to-End OCI Cloud Foundation Observability Operating Model
diagramPatterns.statement: Show how OCI Observability and Management connects every OCI Cloud Foundation domain into one operating model for detection, investigation, alerting, response, remediation, governance, optimization, compliance, and executive visibility.
